featured_reviews.review_text:
My expectations for this trip were honestly quite low, but Adventure Geek completely exceeded them. The entire experience was well organized, enjoyable, and filled with wonderful memories.
One of my biggest concerns before the trip was the washroom facilities, as this was my first adventure trip. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the washrooms were very clean, neat, and well maintained throughout the trip.
A special shoutout to Sohil and Vinay, who led our Mumbai bus group. They guided us exceptionally well, were friendly and approachable, and made the entire journey fun and comfortable. The games and activities they conducted were incredibly fun and interactive. They helped everyone connect, break the ice, and create amazing friendships. In just a short time, a group of strangers turned into a group of friends, and that's something I'll always cherish.
What started as a trip with low expectations turned into one of the most memorable experiences I've had. Thank you, Adventure Geek, for the amazing organization, wonderful memories, and the incredible people we met along the way. We absolutely loved Adventure Geek and can't wait to join another trip soon! ❤️🏕️✨🌿

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Biyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Bhandardara for the fireflies festival not knowing what to expect. I came back with one of the best weekends of my life.

The trip was special not just because of the destination, but because of the people, the group, the conversations, the memories made along the way. That kind of experience doesn't happen by accident.

Our team leaders Sohil sir, Vinay sir, and Ahbas sir made sure no one felt left out, ever. From ice-breaking games on the bus to bonfire stories under the stars, there was never a dull moment. They ran a seamless two days- smooth, organised, and genuinely fun.

The campsite was well-maintained and hygienic, with easy access to washrooms and a restaurant. One tent for two people, comfort was clearly a priority.

The night trek to the fireflies was the highlight for most, and for good reason. Sohil sir made sure everyone reached the peak safely, and when we got there, it felt like a movie. Watching the fireflies glow across the valley, holding one in your hand... that's a once-in-a-lifetime moment. We even got to click pictures with them, thanks to a local who helped us out.

Food was homelike and hearty- roti sabzi and rice for dinner, poha and bread butter for breakfast, and a lunch stop at Shiv Sagar on the road.

But honestly? The return journey might have been the highlight. We played Mafia on the bus back to Mumbai, full bus participation, absolute chaos, core memory unlocked. We also made a reel. Obviously.

If you're looking for a trip that's well-organised AND actually fun, Adventure Geek delivers. Special mention to Vinay sir and Sohil sir, you made this one unforgettable.

highly recommend. 10/10

featured_reviews.name: Parag Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a lovely experience with Adventure Geek to Bhandardhara Camp. Their hospitality & warmth was exceptional. Their inclusive approach was remarkable. Highly recommend to plan your adventure trips with them.

featured_reviews.name: yashika gothwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Thanks to Adventure Geek to make my first fireflies experience beautiful. We went to their Bhandardara camping for this. Stay, food, travel everything was organised. All the team captains were friendly, fun and highly engaging. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Madhulika Chowdhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked the Bhandardhara Lakeside Camping and Firefly event with Adventure Geek, and it turned out to be one of the most beautiful experiences.

Right from registration to payment, everything was smooth and hassle-free. Unlike some other organizers who make the process feel complicated and ask endless questions, the entire experience here was simple and welcoming.

A special mention to Vinay and Sohil — their positive attitude and friendly nature make you feel like you are travelling with family. They make sure that no one feels left out and everyone feels comfortable throughout the trip.

The itinerary was very well planned with timely pickup, a super social environment, and most importantly, a heavenly camping location. The arrangements were excellent — clean toilets, delicious food, clean bedsheets, pillows and blankets inside the tents, and even a proper backup shelter in case of rain.

They took care of every little thing, from fun games to making sure everyone was enjoying. Unlike some trips that mostly focus only on young crowds, this one felt truly family-friendly where people of all age groups could enjoy equally.

The firefly experience was absolutely magical. I really appreciated how they explained everything beforehand — how to observe this beautiful natural phenomenon without disturbing or harming the fireflies, while staying in sync with nature.

Overall, everything was amazing. A big thanks to Vinay and Sohil for putting so much effort into creating such a wonderful experience. Also, our group members played a huge role in making the trip memorable because everyone was so caring and friendly. We were lucky in that aspect too!

We are definitely looking forward to joining more monsoon trips with Adventure Geek.

— Madhulika & Chetan

featured_reviews.review_text: My experience with Adventure Geek was truly wonderful. It was my first trip with them, and it turned out to be an unforgettable one.
